notes.score: breadth (n_scars / n_trees_alive) x R (mean resultant length of scar trough angles, circular concentration 0..1)
notes.gate: scars are forest/prep.py's whole-history drawdown episodes: depth beyond the asset's own vol-derived threshold (15%..50%), underwater >=120 days past trough. Not every dip is a scar.
notes.low_sample: years with fewer than 30 trees alive are flagged low_sample=true -- a lone scar there can fake a perfect R with nothing to disagree with it. Excluded from the ranked headline list, still shown (honestly, dim) on the timeline.
